newsitem.title: USA: NBA basketball-BULLS SIGN BRIAN WILLIAMS FOR STRETCH DRIVE.
newsitem.headline: NBA basketball-BULLS SIGN BRIAN WILLIAMS FOR STRETCH DRIVE.

text.p: The Chicago Bulls, needing some front-line help with injuries to Dennis Rodman and Bill Wennington, signed free agent center/forward Brian Williams, the NBA champions announced on Wednesday.
Williams, a sturdy 6-foot-11 (2.11 m) force under the boards and the 10th overall pick in the 1991 draft by Orlando, had knee surgery in the offseason and has not played since.

The Bulls, who have a league-best 63-9 record, have been hampered recently by injuries to Rodman and Wennington. Wennington may be lost for the season with a foot injury, while Rodman has been sidelined with a sprained knee.

Williams averaged career highs in points (15.8) and rebounds (7.6) last year in 65 games for the Los Angeles Clippers. He became a free agent after the season when he opted out of his contract and then had the surgery.

"The addition of Brian Williams gives us a proven NBA rebounder, scorer and defender to help us on our quest for another championship," said Bulls vice president of basketball operations Jerry Krause.
Williams and Rodman have the same agent, Dwight Manley.
"I haven't played competitively since last season, but the urge to compete and win is stronger than ever," Williams, who turns 28 on Sunday, said in a statement issued by the club.
Krause said Williams would work his way into the Bulls system slowly during the next 10 days and hopes to be in full game condition by the start of the playoffs.
